hub.title: Mojulo Maker
hub.subtitle: The illustration studio: mint landscapes, figures, and 3D scenes, and set them in motion. A tuned creative surface, sibling to Sketches (tuned for diagrams). An illustration is the same sketch primitive — stash, reference, and diff it either way.

illustrations.title: Ilustrasi
illustrations.subtitle: Landscapes, figures, and complicated perspective, CSS-3D, and painterly renders.
illustrations.blurb: Painted landscapes, posed figures, carved solids — the rich visual set you look at.

worlds.title: Dunia
worlds.subtitle: Traversable three.js cityscapes and transportation hubs — drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, move through them.
worlds.blurb: Fractal cities and transportation hubs rendered as navigable 3D worlds, not flat pictures.

motion.title: Gerakan
motion.blurb: Movies and GIFs — camera paths and slideshows rendered to animated artifacts.

beats.title: Rentak
beats.subtitle: Synthesized soundtracks, compositions, and sound effects — select one and press play. Author new ones from your agent via create_beats.
beats.blurb: Ambient loops, scores, and foley cues — the audio artifacts you listen to. Everything synthesized, nothing sampled.

voice.title: Suara
voice.subtitle: Voice registers — deterministic recipes for how a voice sounds: two axes over a calibrated bank of voices. Author new ones from your agent via create_voice; an external worker speaks them.
voice.blurb: Meek to authoritative, bright to deep — voices as tiny blend recipes, never recordings.
voice.noSamples: No rendered samples yet — copy the speak command and have your agent bind a few points (edges included).
voice.empty: No voice registers yet. Ask your agent to mint one with create_voice.
voice.unresolvable: This register no longer resolves — its bank may have changed. Re-mint it via create_voice.
